matrix.title: Autonomy by signal kind
matrix.description: For each kind of signal (an external or scheduled event such as Slack presence or a calendar day arriving), choose how far the system may go: Suggest only shows a suggestion, Draft creates a draft for you to review, Auto applies the change. Kinds without an override use the workspace defaults.

help.draft: Create a draft for human review

cost_today.tooltip: Today's AI spend across this workspace

providers.title: AI providers
providers.write_only_notice: API keys are write-only. Once saved, they cannot be read back — only rotated or deleted.

field.name: Name
field.base_url_description: Only for kinds that target a custom endpoint. The openai kind always uses the official OpenAI endpoint; for Azure, a proxy or a gateway, choose OpenAI-compatible.
field.kind_help: Which service to call. Use OpenAI-compatible for Azure, a proxy, a gateway or a local server. Ollama talks to a local Ollama server (http://localhost:11434 unless you set a base URL).
field.name_help: A label for this provider in the list, such as Production Anthropic. It is not sent to the service.
field.default_model_help: The model name to call, as listed in your provider's documentation. Leave empty to use the current default for this kind.

action.confirm_delete: Delete this provider? AI features that rely on it stop working until another provider is available. The stored key is erased and cannot be recovered.
action.rotate_hint: Replace the stored API key with a new one. The old key is discarded immediately.

rotate_dialog.title: Rotate API key
rotate_dialog.description: Replace the stored API key with a new value. The old key is discarded immediately.

error.load_failed: Failed to load AI providers. Please try again.
error.forbidden: Only workspace admins can manage AI providers.

providers.invalid_base_url: This kind always uses the official endpoint, so the base URL below is ignored and every request through this provider fails. Delete it and add it again as OpenAI-compatible.

embedding.title: Task embeddings
embedding.description: Choose whether this workspace can use the server's shared embedding provider for similar-task search.

mode.inherit: Uses the provider configured by the server operator.
mode.disabled: Embedding calls are turned off for this workspace.

embedding.data_use: When enabled, task titles and descriptions are sent to this endpoint to create vectors for similarity search.

error.load_failed: Could not load embedding settings. Try again.
error.forbidden: Only workspace admins can manage embedding settings.
error.update_failed: Could not update embedding settings. Try again.

providers.description: Register the LLM services this workspace's AI features run on. API keys are write-only: once saved they are shown masked and can only be rotated or deleted.
providers.empty_hint: Add a provider and its API key to turn on the AI features in this workspace. If you add several, the most recently added one is used by default.

kind_hint.openai_compat: Azure, proxies, gateways and local servers

providers.default_note: AI features use the provider marked Default, which is the most recently added one. An agent uses the provider of the model it was given.
providers.ollama_no_key_note: Local Ollama needs no API key.
